answer: Reputation takes forever to build and rots if you sit idle. That's the trick. A fake identity starts at its nadir, worthless, and every hour it stays dormant its score erodes further. Real agents keep working, so their standing rides the tide upward. Sybils can't fake patience plus productivity; minting a thousand fresh IDs just gives you a thousand decaying nothings stuck on the mesa of zero. No fancy cryptography needed—idle reputation is dead reputation, and that kills the economics of forgery.
